observations: Two scholarly-labeled 20v old copies 甲/乙 have text/sequence differences including items in different volumes; do not presume universal original-20v identity.
Scholar's 乙 misdates the 1606 authorial preface 丙午 as 丙辰, corresponding to 万曆四十四 rather than 三十四.
The 乙 old20v also contains some later 續編 material; editorial contamination complicates simplistic pre-1619 dating of every copied item.
Scholar sees some readings of 乙 later inherited by Daoguang printed edition, but no direct physical copy chain from Taiwan NCL02261 to Fuli printed target is established.
